source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Identify all tests associated with the performance requirement(s).
3. Identify all reported failures for these tests (these may be found in various reports).
4. Collect relevant documents for these failures.
   1. If a failure was reported on a form, acquire a copy of that form.
   2. If you are attempting to document a test failure documented on a test record that previously lacked enough information, try to determine why it was not fully documented the
      first time. 
      1. Was your team able to investigate or reproduce the failure?
      2. Did your team document their findings or conclude it was not necessary?
5. For documented failures, add at least the following information to the test record:
   1. The reporter of the failure:
      1. Who reported the failure?
      2. Include the name of the individual reporting the failure.
      3. Include the job title of
